content.title: Oklo & other nuclear stocks climb, Public Storage upgraded
content.description:
Yahoo Finance anchor Josh Lipton tracks Monday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Nuclear stocks, including Oklo (OKLO), NuScale Power (SMR), and Nano Nuclear Energy (NNE), are rising.

Beyond Meat (BYND) stock continues to nosedive after the company's bond investors accepted a debt swap to dilute shares.

Public Storage (PSA) was upgraded to Buy from Hold by Deutsche Bank.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
